title: Rebalance the homepage tree crown and trunk
objective: Preserve the approved open space at the top of the homepage while making the canopy read as a fuller, contoured crown above a visually lower trunk.
acceptance_checks: canopy reads above rather than level with the trunk
trunk still connects continuously to its lower geometry
canopy gains visible volume without reducing hero readability
route and content layers remain unchanged

result.summary: The approved upper gap is preserved while eight overlapping organic crown volumes and eight internal contours give the canopy more mass; the visible trunk now begins lower and tapers into the unchanged lower trunk, cave, and root geometry.
checks: JSON, YAML, and HTML parser checks
route, content, cave, and root geometry visually unchanged below the scoped junction
existing reduced-motion rule still disables canopy animation

reviews.orchestrator_accessibility_review: pass: primary and secondary hero text remain clearly legible over the stronger but low-opacity canopy
reviews.orchestrator_visual_integration_review: pass: crown now reads above the lower trunk and the full-page tree remains continuous
